sources.snippet: ← Back to Liquid Nanos LFM2-350M-ENJP-MT is a specialized translation model for near real-time bidirectional Japanese/English translation. Optimized for short-to-medium text with low latency.

sources.snippet: LFM2-350M-ENJP-MT-GGUF Based on the LFM2-350M model, this checkpoint has been fine-tuned for near real-time bi-directional Japanese/English translation of short-to-medium inputs.

sources.title: LiquidAI/LFM2-350M-ENJP-MT Open-source Translation Model - Supports ...
sources.snippet: This is a statically quantized version of the LiquidAI/LFM2-350M-ENJP-MT model, supporting bidirectional translation tasks between English and Japanese. It is optimized for edge computing scenarios and offers various quantization options to meet different hardware requirements.
